The Chinese characters for Gregory

As a transliteration, Gregory is usually written 格雷戈里 (Gé léi gē lǐ). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Origin and meaning

Gregory is a Greek name meaning “watchful, alert”.

About the name Gregory

The name of several popes, including Pope Gregory the Great.

The name Gregory suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
